name: Jonathan Harvey
bio: a Representative from New Hampshire; born in Sutton, Merrimack County, N.H., February 25, 1780; attended the common schools; engaged in agricultural pursuits; member of the New Hampshire state house of representatives 1811-1816, 1831-1834, and 1838-1840; served in the New Hampshire state senate, 1816-1823, and was president of that body 1817-1823; member of the executive council 1823-1825; elected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Nineteenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (March 4, 1825-March 3, 1831); was not a candidate for renomination in 1830; retired to his farm at North Sutton, N.H., where he died on August 23, 1859; interment in North Sutton Cemetery.
